test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 23 Oct, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Kudumbashree is a poverty eradication and women empowerment programme. In which state of India does this programme operate?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Kerala**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kudumbashree** is a **poverty eradication and women empowerment programme** implemented in the Indian state of **Kerala**.
 
• The programme was launched in **1998** by the Government of Kerala and is considered one of the largest women-oriented initiatives in Asia.
 
• It operates through **three-tier community structures**, consisting of **Neighborhood Groups (NHGs)**, Area Development Societies (ADS), and Community Development Societies (CDS).
 
• Its primary objective is to empower women by engaging them in **entrepreneurship, skill development, and decision-making processes**.
 
• **Kudumbashree** has been instrumental in enhancing rural livelihoods by promoting **microfinance** and supporting small-scale businesses.
 
• The programme has contributed to significant **social and economic advancements**, including poverty reduction and improved gender equality in Kerala.
 
• Kudumbashree is closely linked with Kerala's **Local Self-Governments** to ensure efficient implementation and community participation.
 
• It engages in various sectors like **agriculture, animal husbandry, handicrafts, food processing, and tourism** to generate sustainable income sources.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Tamil Nadu**__

 __
 
• Tamil Nadu is known for its **Self-Help Group (SHG) movement**, but Kudumbashree is specifically implemented in Kerala.
 
• Tamil Nadu has various initiatives like **Pudhu Vaazhvu Project** for poverty eradication and women empowerment.
 
 
 
• **Andhra Pradesh**__
 __
 
• Andhra Pradesh has significant rural development programmes such as **DWCRA (Development of Women and Children in Rural Areas).**
 
• The state is also known for its **SHG-based microfinance model** under the **Velugu Project**.
 
 
 
• **Karnataka**__
 
 
• Karnataka implements various poverty alleviation schemes, including the **Stree Shakti Programme** to empower women.
 
• Kudumbashree is not operational in Karnataka as it is exclusive to Kerala.
